summary: useGraphViewport: one pan-and-zoom transform for an HTML node layer and an SVG edge layer — wheel and trackpad-pinch zoom at the pointer, drag to pan, zoom-in, zoom-out and fit actions (Diagram and Network bind them to +, - and 0), fit on first layout until the reader takes over, and follow-focus that brings a focused node into view with a 24px margin (SC 2.4.11). Scale clamps to 0.25–2 by default. Shared by Diagram and Network.
